note: Export side is genuinely factual: dated outbound customs entries with B/L numbers, destination ports and HS codes (90219090 to Vietnam 2026-02-25; 85437099 to Italy 2026-02-19), plus repeat-buyer aggregates pointing to a standing Vietnam/Indonesia/Ecuador medical-device channel.
